title: VMF decision carry note
description: DECIDE-CARRY-KILL-1: the note of the carry a decision is about to do, at decision-carry/<machine key>.json in the run store. Resolve-VmfDecision writes it BEFORE it writes the decision into the plan, and removes it after it carries the wave's accepted settings, its approval and the plan sign-off onto the plan it wrote (Invoke-VmfDecisionCarryForward). A process that stopped between the two leaves it, and the next decision call for the machine finishes the carry - only while the stored plan's version is still afterPlanVersion. Written and read by the engine only.

vmId.description: The machine the decision is for, as the run's record spells it.

wave.description: The machine's wave: the wave whose acceptance and approval the carry moves.

decidedBy.description: Who made the decision. The carry's amendments name this person, not whoever finishes the carry.

decidedUtc.description: When the decision was made. The carry's amendments carry this time.

change.description: The settings the decision changed, as setting=value, comma separated.

carryWaveApproval.description: WAVE-APPROVE-1: true only for an approver's acceptance of the one decision the machine waited for. Only then does the carry move the wave's approval.

before.description: What the wave's records had to sign immediately before the decision (Get-VmfDecisionSnapshot of the plan text the decision read). A record that signs anything else is not moved.

afterPlanVersion.description: The document version of the plan text the decision wrote. The carry is finished only while the stored plan has this version.
